Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Singleton Pattern Implementation
sections.body:
Create a `Logger` class using the Singleton pattern with:
- Thread-safe singleton implementation
- Logging methods (info, warning, error, debug)
- Log rotation and file management
- Configuration options (log level, file path, format)
- Class methods for logger configuration
- Static methods for utility functions

sections.title: Exercise 2: Factory Pattern with Multiple Types
sections.body:
Create a `VehicleFactory` system with:
- Abstract `Vehicle` class with common methods
- Concrete vehicle classes (Car, Motorcycle, Truck, Bus)
- Simple factory for basic vehicle creation
- Factory method pattern for specialized vehicle creation
- Abstract factory for vehicle families (Electric, Gasoline, Hybrid)
- Configuration-based factory creation

sections.title: Exercise 3: Observer Pattern for Stock Market
sections.body:
Create a stock market monitoring system with:
- `Stock` class as the subject with price updates
- Multiple observer types (Display, Alert, Logger, EmailNotifier)
- Event filtering and priority system
- Observer registration/unregistration management
- Batch notification system
- Performance monitoring for observers

sections.title: Exercise 4: Strategy Pattern for Payment Processing
sections.body:
Create a payment processing system with:
- Abstract `PaymentStrategy` interface
- Multiple payment strategies (CreditCard, PayPal, BankTransfer, Crypto)
- Payment validation and security checks
- Transaction logging and reporting
- Payment method selection based on user preferences
- Refund and cancellation strategies

sections.title: Exercise 5: Decorator Pattern for Coffee Shop
sections.body:
Create a coffee shop ordering system with:
- Base `Coffee` class with cost and description
- Multiple coffee types (Espresso, Latte, Cappuccino)
- Decorator classes for add-ons (Milk, Sugar, Whip, Syrup, Ice)
- Dynamic pricing calculation
- Order customization and validation
- Receipt generation with detailed breakdown

sections.title: Exercise 6: Command Pattern for Smart Home
sections.body:
Create a smart home automation system with:
- Abstract `Command` interface with execute/undo methods
- Device classes (Light, Thermostat, Door, MusicPlayer)
- Command classes for each device operation
- Remote control with multiple slots
- Macro commands for complex operations
- Command history and replay functionality

sections.title: Exercise 7: Adapter Pattern for Legacy Systems
sections.body:
Create an adapter system for:
- Legacy database interface adaptation
- Third-party API integration
- File format conversion (CSV to JSON, XML to YAML)
- Protocol adaptation (HTTP to WebSocket)
- Data structure transformation
- Error handling and fallback mechanisms

sections.title: Exercise 8: Template Method for Data Processing
sections.body:
Create a data processing framework with:
- Abstract `DataProcessor` class with template method
- Concrete processors (CSV, JSON, XML, Database)
- Validation and transformation hooks
- Error handling and recovery mechanisms
- Progress tracking and reporting
- Batch processing capabilities

sections.title: Exercise 9: Builder Pattern for Complex Objects
sections.body:
Create a `ComputerBuilder` system with:
- Complex `Computer` class with many components
- Builder interface with fluent API
- Concrete builders for different computer types (Gaming, Office, Server)
- Component validation and compatibility checking
- Price calculation and optimization
- Configuration persistence and loading

sections.title: Exercise 10: State Pattern for Game Character
sections.body:
Create a game character state system with:
- Character class with different states (Idle, Walking, Running, Fighting, Sleeping)
- State transitions with conditions
- State-specific behavior and animations
- State history and rollback capability
- State persistence and loading
- Performance monitoring for state changes

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Composite Pattern for File System
Build a file system browser with:
- Composite pattern for files and directories
- Recursive operations (search, copy, delete)
- Size calculation and statistics
- Permission management
- File type detection and handling
- Tree visualization and navigation

### Challenge 2: Chain of Responsibility for Request Processing
Create a request processing pipeline with:
- Multiple handlers for different request types
- Authentication, authorization, validation, logging handlers
- Request transformation and routing
- Error handling and recovery
- Performance monitoring and metrics
- Dynamic handler configuration

### Challenge 3: Memento Pattern for Text Editor
Build a text editor with undo/redo functionality:
- Document state management with mementos
- Multiple undo levels and memory management
- State compression and optimization
- Collaborative editing support
- Auto-save and recovery mechanisms
- Change tracking and version control

### Challenge 4: Visitor Pattern for Document Processing
Create a document processing system with:
- Document elements (Paragraph, Image, Table, Chart)
- Visitors for different operations (Export, SpellCheck, Format)
- Extensible visitor framework
- Performance optimization for large documents
- Batch processing capabilities
- Custom visitor creation and registration

### Challenge 5: Proxy Pattern for Resource Management
Build a resource management system with:
- Virtual proxy for lazy loading
- Protection proxy for access control
- Remote proxy for network resources
- Caching proxy for performance optimization
- Logging proxy for monitoring
- Resource pooling and lifecycle management

sections.title: Implementation Guidelines
sections.body:
### Design Pattern Best Practices
- Choose patterns based on actual problem requirements
- Keep implementations simple and focused
- Document pattern usage and rationale
- Test pattern implementations thoroughly
- Consider performance implications
- Use patterns consistently across the codebase

### Testing Strategy
- Test each pattern implementation independently
- Verify pattern behavior with different scenarios
- Test pattern interactions and combinations
- Ensure proper error handling and edge cases
- Performance testing for resource-intensive patterns
- Integration testing for complex pattern systems

### Documentation Requirements
- Explain pattern choice and implementation
- Document pattern interfaces and contracts
- Provide usage examples and best practices
- Include performance considerations
- Document pattern limitations and alternatives
- Maintain pattern catalog and reference guide
